messages.text:
"Create an ultra-realistic 3D open-world city game.

GRAPHICS:
- Photorealistic 3D environments.
- Realistic lighting and shadows.
- High-quality building textures.
- Realistic reflections on glass.
- Dynamic weather.
- Rain with realistic puddles.
- Beautiful sunset and nighttime lighting.

WORLD:
- Huge modern city.
- Detailed skyscrapers.
- Residential neighborhoods.
- Shopping malls.
- Gas stations.
- Parks and beaches.
- Realistic roads and sidewalks.

GAMEPLAY:
- Third-person camera.
- Realistic walking and running animations.
- Drive realistic cars.
- Traffic system.
- Pedestrians walking around.
- Interactive buildings.
- Garages and shops.
- Open-world exploration.

MOBILE:
- Android tablet touchscreen controls.
- Virtual joystick.
- Camera movement controls.
- Driving buttons.
- Fullscreen mode.
- Optimize performance for Samsung tablets.

Build the game step by step.
Prioritize graphics and smooth performance.
Make everything playable.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
